Two trailing spaces end this line.\\
So this line starts fresh. A backslash also forces a break\\
and this is the last line of the paragraph.

A soft line break with one trailing space renders as a single space.

\begin{quote}
And this one\\
has multiple lines\\
in it.

\end{quote}

\textbf{Bold text}\\
then \texttt{code}\\
then plain.

Trailing spaces on the final line are not a break.

\begin{lstlisting}
code keeps its trailing spaces  
verbatim
\end{lstlisting}
